g.text: Co-firing predicts the sign of causal interaction

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #2a78d6; stroke-width: 4.93; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #eb6834; stroke-width: 4.93; stroke-linecap: square

font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Co-activation is the frozen fingerprint posterior, the same quantity the streaming assignment uses. Lift = Coact(a,b) / p(a)p(b) — how much more

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: two components fire together than their marginals predict. Synergy is measured by ablating whole components: dCE(both) − dCE(a) − dCE(b), relative to

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: the main effects. Both arms are drawn from the SAME pool of components (those whose single ablation is measurable), so main effects are matched and only

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: the pairing differs. Components that fire together need each other; components that never fire together partly substitute for each other.
